Common YANG Data Types for Traffic Engineering
contents.ja: トラフィックエンジニアリングのための共通YANGデータ型

contents.text: Abstract
contents.ja: 要約

contents.text: This document defines a collection of commonly used Traffic Engineering (TE) specific data types, identities, and groupings in YANG data modeling language. These derived common data types, identities, and groupings are intended to be imported by other modules that model configuration and state for TE constructs, such as TE topologies, TE tunnels, TE policies, TE paths, TE Label Switched Paths (LSPs), and TE interfaces.
contents.ja: 本書は、YANGデータモデリング言語における、トラフィックエンジニアリング (TE) に固有の一般的に使用されるデータ型、アイデンティティ、およびグルーピングの集合を定義します。これらの派生した共通のデータ型、アイデンティティ、およびグルーピングは、TEトポロジ、TEトンネル、TEポリシー、TEパス、TEラベルスイッチドパス (LSP)、TEインターフェースなどのTE構成要素の設定と状態をモデル化する他のモジュールによってインポートされることを意図しています。

1. Introduction
contents.ja: 1. はじめに

contents.text: YANG [RFC6020] [RFC7950] is a data modeling language used to model configuration data, state data, Remote Procedure Calls, and notifications for network management protocols such as the Network Configuration Protocol (NETCONF) [RFC6241] or RESTCONF [RFC8040]. The YANG language supports a small set of built-in data types and provides mechanisms to derive other types from the built-in types.
contents.ja: YANG [RFC6020] [RFC7950] は、Network Configuration Protocol (NETCONF) [RFC6241] や RESTCONF [RFC8040] などのネットワーク管理プロトコルのための設定データ、状態データ、リモートプロシージャコール、および通知をモデル化するために使用されるデータモデリング言語です。YANG言語は少数の組み込みデータ型をサポートし、組み込み型から他の型を派生させるためのメカニズムを提供します。

contents.text: This document introduces a collection of commonly used Traffic Engineering (TE) data types derived from the built-in YANG data types. The derived data types, identities, and groupings form common definitions applicable to modeling TE features in models defined outside of this document. These derived common data types, identities, and groupings are intended to be imported by other modules that model TE constructs, such as TE topologies, TE tunnels, TE policies, TE paths, TE Label Switched Paths (LSPs), and TE interfaces. Nevertheless, these common definitions can be used by any other module per the guidance in Sections 4.12 and 4.13 of [RFC9907]. An importing module is not required to use all the definitions provided by the types module.
contents.ja: 本書は、YANGの組み込みデータ型から派生した、一般的に使用されるトラフィックエンジニアリング (TE) のデータ型の集合を導入します。派生データ型、アイデンティティ、およびグルーピングは、本書の外で定義されるモデルにおいてTE機能をモデル化する際に適用できる共通の定義を構成します。これらの派生した共通のデータ型、アイデンティティ、およびグルーピングは、TEトポロジ、TEトンネル、TEポリシー、TEパス、TEラベルスイッチドパス (LSP)、TEインターフェースなどのTE構成要素をモデル化する他のモジュールによってインポートされることを意図しています。とはいえ、これらの共通定義は、[RFC9907] のセクション4.12および4.13のガイダンスに従って、他のどのモジュールでも使用できます。インポートするモジュールは、types モジュールが提供するすべての定義を使用する必要はありません。

contents.text: Note: Some groupings defined in this document include "default" statements, contrary to the guidelines in Section 4.13 of [RFC9907]. This is due to the fact that they were already defined in [RFC8776] and removing "default" statements is not a backward compatible change, as defined in Section 11 of [RFC7950].
contents.ja: 注記：本書で定義されるいくつかのグルーピングには、[RFC9907] のセクション4.13のガイドラインに反して、"default" ステートメントが含まれています。これは、それらが [RFC8776] ですでに定義されており、[RFC7950] のセクション11で定義されているとおり、"default" ステートメントを削除することは後方互換な変更ではないためです。

contents.text: This document adds new common data types, identities, and groupings to both the "ietf-te-types" and the "ietf-te-packet-types" YANG modules and obsoletes [RFC8776]. For further details, refer to Appendix B.
contents.ja: 本書は、"ietf-te-types" と "ietf-te-packet-types" の両方のYANGモジュールに新しい共通データ型、アイデンティティ、およびグルーピングを追加し、[RFC8776] を廃止します。詳細については、付録Bを参照してください。

contents.text: 3. Overview
contents.ja: 3. 概要

contents.text: This document defines two YANG modules for common TE types: "ietf-te-types" (Section 4) for TE generic types and "ietf-te-packet-types" (Section 5) for packet-specific types. Other technology-specific TE types are outside the scope of this document.

contents.text: 3.1. TE Types Module Contents
contents.ja: 3.1. TEタイプモジュールの内容

contents.text: The "ietf-te-types" module (Section 4) contains TE types that are commonly used across multiple TE technology-specific modules.
contents.ja: "ietf-te-types" モジュール (セクション4) には、複数の技術固有のTEモジュールにまたがって共通に使用されるTE型が含まれます。

contents.ja: restoration-scheme-type:

contents.text: association-type:
contents.ja: association-type:

contents.ja: [RFC6780]、[RFC4872]、[RFC4873]、[RFC8800] で定義されている、サポートされるLSP関連付けタイプのベースアイデンティティです。

contents.text: objective-function-type:
contents.ja: objective-function-type:

contents.text: A base identity for supported path objective functions as defined in [RFC5541].
contents.ja: [RFC5541] で定義されている、サポートされるパス目的関数のベースアイデンティティです。

contents.text: te-tunnel-type:
contents.ja: te-tunnel-type:

contents.text: Additional technology-specific interface switching capabilities can be defined in technology-specific modules.
contents.ja: 追加の技術固有のインターフェーススイッチング能力は、技術固有のモジュールで定義できます。

contents.text: resource-affinities-type:
contents.ja: resource-affinities-type:

contents.ja: [RFC3209] と [RFC2702] で定義されている、リンクが許容可能となるために満たさなければならない、トンネルに関連付けられたサポート対象の属性フィルタのベースアイデンティティです。

contents.text: path-metric-type:
contents.ja: path-metric-type:

contents.text: A base identity for supported path metric types as defined in [RFC3630], [RFC3785], [RFC5440], [RFC7471], [RFC8233], [RFC8570], and [RFC9933].
contents.ja: [RFC3630]、[RFC3785]、[RFC5440]、[RFC7471]、[RFC8233]、[RFC8570]、[RFC9933] で定義されている、サポートされるパスメトリックタイプのベースアイデンティティです。

contents.text: The unit of the path metric value is interpreted in the context of the path metric type. The derived identities MUST describe the unit and maximum value of the path metric types they define.
contents.ja: パスメトリック値の単位は、パスメトリックタイプの文脈で解釈されます。派生アイデンティティは、それが定義するパスメトリックタイプの単位と最大値を記述しなければなりません (MUST)。

contents.text: For example, the measurement unit is not applicable for the number of hops metric ('path-metric-hop'). Conversely, the bound of the 'path-metric-loss', defined in "ietf-te-packet-types", is defined in multiples of the basic unit 0.000003% as described in [RFC7471] and [RFC8570].
contents.ja: 例えば、ホップ数メトリック ('path-metric-hop') には測定単位は適用されません。逆に、"ietf-te-packet-types" で定義される 'path-metric-loss' の上限は、[RFC7471] と [RFC8570] に記載されているとおり、基本単位 0.000003% の倍数で定義されます。

contents.text: 3.1.1.1. Path Computation Errors
contents.ja: 3.1.1.1. パス計算エラー

contents.text: The "ietf-te-types" module contains the YANG reusable identities for indicating path computation error reasons as defined in [RFC5440], [RFC5441], [RFC5520], [RFC5557], [RFC8306], and [RFC8685].
contents.ja: "ietf-te-types" モジュールは、[RFC5440]、[RFC5441]、[RFC5520]、[RFC5557]、[RFC8306]、[RFC8685] で定義されるパス計算エラーの理由を示すための、再利用可能なYANGアイデンティティを含みます。

contents.text: It also defines the following additional YANG reusable identities for indicating the following path computation error reasons:
contents.ja: このモジュールはまた、次のパス計算エラーの理由を示すための、再利用可能なYANGアイデンティティを以下のとおり追加で定義します。

contents.text: path-computation-error-no-topology:
contents.ja: path-computation-error-no-topology:

contents.text: A base identity for indicating the path computation error when there is no topology with the provided topology identifier.
contents.ja: 指定されたトポロジ識別子を持つトポロジが存在しない場合のパス計算エラーを示すためのベースアイデンティティです。

contents.text: path-computation-error-no-dependent-server:
contents.ja: path-computation-error-no-dependent-server:

contents.text: A base identity for indicating the path computation error when one or more dependent path computation servers are unavailable.
contents.ja: 依存する1つ以上のパス計算サーバが利用できない場合のパス計算エラーを示すためのベースアイデンティティです。

contents.text: The dependent path computation server could be a Backward-Recursive PCE-based Computation (BRPC) downstream PCE, as defined in [RFC5441], or a child PCE, as defined in [RFC8685].
contents.ja: 依存するパス計算サーバは、[RFC5441] で定義されるBackward-Recursive PCE-based Computation (BRPC) の下流PCEである場合や、[RFC8685] で定義される子PCEである場合があります。

contents.text: The derived identities are defined in the "ietf-te-types" module, instead of an IANA-maintained module, because of error reasons that:
contents.ja: 派生アイデンティティは、IANAが管理するモジュールではなく "ietf-te-types" モジュールで定義されます。これは、次のようなエラーの理由があるためです。

contents.text: 1. are applicable only to the TE YANG modules and not to Path Computation Element Communication Protocol (PCEP) environments (e.g., path-computation-error-no-topology);
contents.ja: 1. TEのYANGモジュールにのみ適用され、Path Computation Element Communication Protocol (PCEP) 環境には適用されないもの (例: path-computation-error-no-topology)。

contents.text: 2. are technology-specific, which are better defined in technology-specific YANG modules;
contents.ja: 2. 技術固有であり、技術固有のYANGモジュールで定義するほうが適しているもの。

contents.text: 3. match more than one PCEP number in order to hide the details of the underlay PCE architecture (e.g., path-computation-error-no-dependent-server).
contents.ja: 3. 下位のPCEアーキテクチャの詳細を隠蔽するために、複数のPCEP番号に対応するもの (例: path-computation-error-no-dependent-server)。

contents.text: 3.1.1.2. Protocol Origin
contents.ja: 3.1.1.2. プロトコルオリジン

contents.text: The protocol origin identifies the protocol or mechanism a controller uses to instantiate a TE tunnel. To model this, the "ietf-te-types" module provides a set of reusable YANG identities. In addition to identities for protocols like PCEP [RFC5440] and BGP [RFC9012], the module defines the following identity for tunnels created via an Application Programming Interface (API):
contents.ja: プロトコルオリジンは、コントローラがTEトンネルをインスタンス化するために使用するプロトコルまたはメカニズムを識別します。これをモデル化するために、"ietf-te-types" モジュールは再利用可能なYANGアイデンティティの集合を提供します。PCEP [RFC5440] やBGP [RFC9012] などのプロトコルに対するアイデンティティに加えて、このモジュールはアプリケーションプログラミングインターフェース (API) を介して作成されるトンネルに対する次のアイデンティティを定義します。

contents.text: protocol-origin-api:
contents.ja: protocol-origin-api:

contents.text: A YANG identity used when the TE tunnel is instantiated through an API.
contents.ja: TEトンネルがAPIを介してインスタンス化される場合に使用されるYANGアイデンティティです。

contents.text: 3.1.2. Data Types
contents.ja: 3.1.2. データ型

contents.text: The "ietf-te-types" module contains the following YANG reusable data types:
contents.ja: "ietf-te-types" モジュールは、再利用可能な次のYANGデータ型を含みます。

contents.text: te-ds-class:
contents.ja: te-ds-class:

contents.text: A type representing the Differentiated Services (DS) Class-Type of traffic as defined in [RFC4124].
contents.ja: [RFC4124] で定義される、トラフィックのDifferentiated Services (DS) クラスタイプを表す型です。

contents.text: te-label-direction:
contents.ja: te-label-direction:

contents.text: An enumerated type for specifying the forward or reverse direction of a label.
contents.ja: ラベルの順方向または逆方向を指定するための列挙型です。

contents.text: te-hop-type:
contents.ja: te-hop-type:

contents.text: An enumerated type for specifying that a hop is loose or strict.
contents.ja: ホップがルーズかストリクトかを指定するための列挙型です。

contents.text: te-global-id:
contents.ja: te-global-id:

contents.text: A type representing the identifier that uniquely identifies an operator, which can be either a provider or a client. The definition of this type is taken from Section 3 of [RFC6370] and Section 3 of [RFC5003]. This attribute type is used solely to provide a globally unique context for TE topologies.
contents.ja: 事業者 (プロバイダまたはクライアントのいずれか) を一意に識別する識別子を表す型です。この型の定義は、[RFC6370] のセクション3および [RFC5003] のセクション3から引用しています。この属性型は、TEトポロジにグローバルに一意なコンテキストを提供するためだけに使用されます。

contents.text: te-node-id:
contents.ja: te-node-id:

contents.text: A type representing the identifier for a node in a TE topology. The identifier is represented either as 4 octets in dotted-quad notation or as 16 octets in an IPv6 address notation [RFC5952].
contents.ja: TEトポロジ内のノードの識別子を表す型です。識別子は、ドット付き4つ組表記の4オクテット、またはIPv6アドレス表記 [RFC5952] の16オクテットのいずれかで表されます。

contents.text: This attribute MAY be mapped to the Router Address TLV described in Section 2.4.1 of [RFC3630], the TE Router ID described in Section 6.2 of [RFC6827], the TE Router ID TLV described in Section 4.3 of [RFC5305], or the TE Router ID TLV described in Section 3.2.1 of [RFC6119].
contents.ja: この属性は、[RFC3630] のセクション2.4.1に記述されているRouter Address TLV、[RFC6827] のセクション6.2に記述されているTE Router ID、[RFC5305] のセクション4.3に記述されているTE Router ID TLV、または [RFC6119] のセクション3.2.1に記述されているTE Router ID TLVにマッピングしてもよい (MAY)。

contents.text: The reachability of such a TE node MAY be achieved by a mechanism such as that described in Section 6.2 of [RFC6827].
contents.ja: このようなTEノードへの到達可能性は、[RFC6827] のセクション6.2に記述されているようなメカニズムによって実現してもよい (MAY)。

contents.text: te-topology-id:
contents.ja: te-topology-id:

contents.text: A type representing the identifier for a topology. It is optional to have one or more prefixes at the beginning, separated by colons. The prefixes can be "network-types" as defined in the "ietf-network" module in [RFC8345], to help the user better understand the topology before further inquiry is made.
contents.ja: トポロジの識別子を表す型です。先頭にコロンで区切られた1つ以上のプレフィックスを付けることは任意です。プレフィックスは、[RFC8345] の "ietf-network" モジュールで定義される "network-types" とすることができ、ユーザがさらに問い合わせを行う前にトポロジをよりよく理解するのに役立ちます。

contents.text: te-tp-id:
contents.ja: te-tp-id:

contents.text: A type representing the identifier of a TE interface Link Termination Point (LTP) on a specific TE node where the TE link connects. This attribute is mapped to a local or remote link identifier [RFC3630] [RFC5305].
contents.ja: TEリンクが接続する特定のTEノード上の、TEインターフェースのリンク終端点 (LTP) の識別子を表す型です。この属性は、ローカルまたはリモートのリンク識別子 [RFC3630] [RFC5305] にマッピングされます。

contents.text: te-path-disjointness:
contents.ja: te-path-disjointness:

contents.text: A type representing the different resource disjointness options for a TE tunnel path as defined in [RFC4872].
contents.ja: [RFC4872] で定義されている、TEトンネルパスに対するさまざまなリソースのディスジョイントネスのオプションを表す型です。

contents.text: admin-groups:
contents.ja: admin-groups:

contents.text: A union type for a TE link's classic administrative groups, as defined in [RFC3630] and [RFC5305], or extended administrative groups, as defined in [RFC7308].
contents.ja: [RFC3630] および [RFC5305] で定義されているTEリンクの従来の管理グループ、または [RFC7308] で定義されている拡張管理グループのためのユニオン型です。

contents.text: srlg:
contents.ja: srlg:

contents.text: A type representing the SRLG as defined in [RFC4203] and [RFC5307].
contents.ja: [RFC4203] および [RFC5307] で定義されているSRLGを表す型です。

contents.text: te-metric:
contents.ja: te-metric:

contents.text: A type representing the TE metric as defined in [RFC3785].
contents.ja: [RFC3785] で定義されているTEメトリックを表す型です。

contents.text: te-recovery-status:
contents.ja: te-recovery-status:

contents.text: An enumerated type for the different status of a recovery action as defined in [RFC6378] and [RFC4427].
contents.ja: [RFC6378] および [RFC4427] で定義されている、回復動作のさまざまなステータスのための列挙型です。

contents.text: te-link-access-type:
contents.ja: te-link-access-type:

contents.text: An enumerated type for the different TE link access types as defined in [RFC3630].
contents.ja: [RFC3630] で定義されているTEリンクのさまざまなアクセスタイプのための列挙型です。

contents.text: 3.1.3. Groupings
contents.ja: 3.1.3. グルーピング

contents.text: The "ietf-te-types" module contains the following YANG reusable groupings:
contents.ja: "ietf-te-types" モジュールには、次のYANG再利用可能グルーピングが含まれています。

contents.text: te-bandwidth:
contents.ja: te-bandwidth:

contents.text: A grouping that defines the generic TE bandwidth. The modeling structure allows augmentation for each technology. For unspecified technologies, the string-encoded "te-bandwidth" type is used.
contents.ja: 汎用的なTE帯域幅を定義するグルーピングです。このモデリング構造により、技術ごとの拡張 (augmentation) が可能です。未指定の技術には、文字列エンコードされた "te-bandwidth" 型が使用されます。

contents.text: te-label:
contents.ja: te-label:

contents.text: A grouping that defines the generic TE label. The modeling structure allows augmentation for each technology. For unspecified technologies, "rt-types:generalized-label" is used.
contents.ja: 汎用的なTEラベルを定義するグルーピングです。このモデリング構造により、技術ごとの拡張 (augmentation) が可能です。未指定の技術には、"rt-types:generalized-label" が使用されます。

contents.text: performance-metrics-attributes:
contents.ja: performance-metrics-attributes:

contents.text: A grouping that defines one-way and two-way measured PM and indications of anomalies on links or the path as defined in [RFC7471], [RFC8570], [RFC7823], [RFC7679], and [RFC2681].
contents.ja: [RFC7471]、[RFC8570]、[RFC7823]、[RFC7679]、[RFC2681] で定義されている、リンクまたはパス上の片方向および双方向の測定済みPMと、異常の指標を定義するグルーピングです。

contents.text: performance-metrics-throttle-container:
contents.ja: performance-metrics-throttle-container:

contents.text: A grouping that defines thresholds for advertisement suppression and measurement intervals.
contents.ja: アドバータイズの抑制のしきい値と測定間隔を定義するグルーピングです。

contents.text: explicit-route-hop:
contents.ja: explicit-route-hop:

contents.text: A grouping that defines supported explicit routes as defined in [RFC3209] and [RFC3477].
contents.ja: [RFC3209] および [RFC3477] で定義されている、サポートされる明示的ルートを定義するグルーピングです。

contents.text: explicit-route-hop-with-srlg:
contents.ja: explicit-route-hop-with-srlg:

contents.text: A grouping that augments the 'explicit-route-hop' to also specify SRLG hops.
contents.ja: 'explicit-route-hop' を拡張して、SRLGホップも指定できるようにするグルーピングです。

contents.text: encoding-and-switching-type:
contents.ja: encoding-and-switching-type:

contents.text: A grouping that defines the LSP encoding and switching types.
contents.ja: LSPのエンコーディングタイプとスイッチングタイプを定義するグルーピングです。

contents.text: 3.2. Packet TE Types Module Contents
contents.ja: 3.2. パケットTEタイプモジュールの内容

contents.text: The "ietf-te-packet-types" module (Section 5) covers the common types and groupings that are specific to packet technology.
contents.ja: "ietf-te-packet-types" モジュール (セクション5) は、パケット技術に固有の共通の型とグルーピングを扱います。

contents.text: 3.2.1. Identities
contents.ja: 3.2.1. アイデンティティ

contents.text: The "ietf-te-packet-types" module contains the following YANG reusable identities:
contents.ja: "ietf-te-packet-types" モジュールには、次のYANG再利用可能アイデンティティが含まれています。

contents.text: backup-protection-type:
contents.ja: backup-protection-type:

contents.text: A base identity for supported protection types that a backup or bypass tunnel can provide as defined in [RFC4090].
contents.ja: [RFC4090] で定義されている、バックアップトンネルまたはバイパストンネルが提供できる、サポートされる保護タイプのベースアイデンティティです。

contents.text: bc-model-type:
contents.ja: bc-model-type:

contents.text: A base identity for supported Diffserv-TE Bandwidth Constraints Models as defined in [RFC4125], [RFC4126], and [RFC4127].
contents.ja: [RFC4125]、[RFC4126]、[RFC4127] で定義されている、サポートされるDiffserv-TE帯域幅制約モデルのベースアイデンティティです。

contents.text: bandwidth-profile-type:
contents.ja: bandwidth-profile-type:

contents.text: A base identity for various bandwidth profiles, also known as traffic profiles in Section 2.3.2 of [RFC2475], that may be used to specify the temporal properties of a packet stream (e.g., MPLS-TE LSPs) as specified in [MEF_10.3], [RFC2697], and [RFC2698].
contents.ja: さまざまな帯域幅プロファイルのベースアイデンティティです。帯域幅プロファイルは、[RFC2475] のセクション2.3.2ではトラフィックプロファイルとも呼ばれ、[MEF_10.3]、[RFC2697]、[RFC2698] で規定されているように、パケットストリーム (例: MPLS-TE LSP) の時間的特性を指定するために使用されることがあります。

contents.text: 3.2.2. Data Types
contents.ja: 3.2.2. データ型

contents.text: The "ietf-te-packet-types" module contains the following YANG reusable data type:
contents.ja: "ietf-te-packet-types" モジュールには、次のYANG再利用可能データ型が含まれます。

contents.text: te-bandwidth-requested-type:
contents.ja: te-bandwidth-requested-type:

contents.text: An enumerated type for the different options to request bandwidth for a specific tunnel.
contents.ja: 特定のトンネルに対して帯域幅を要求する際のさまざまなオプションを表す列挙型です。

contents.text: 3.2.3. Groupings
contents.ja: 3.2.3. グルーピング

contents.text: The "ietf-te-packet-types" module contains the following YANG reusable groupings:
contents.ja: "ietf-te-packet-types" モジュールには、次のYANG再利用可能グルーピングが含まれます。

contents.text: performance-metrics-attributes-packet:
contents.ja: performance-metrics-attributes-packet:

contents.text: A grouping that contains the generic PM and additional packet-specific metrics.
contents.ja: 汎用のPMと、パケット固有の追加メトリックを含むグルーピングです。

contents.text: bandwidth-profile-parameters:
contents.ja: bandwidth-profile-parameters:

contents.text: A grouping that defines common parameters for bandwidth profiles in packet networks.
contents.ja: パケットネットワークにおける帯域幅プロファイルの共通パラメータを定義するグルーピングです。

contents.text: te-packet-path-bandwidth:
contents.ja: te-packet-path-bandwidth:

contents.text: A grouping that defines the path bandwidth information and could be used in any packet TE model (e.g., MPLS-TE topology model) for the path bandwidth representation (e.g., the bandwidth of an MPLS-TE LSP).
contents.ja: パスの帯域幅情報を定義するグルーピングです。パスの帯域幅の表現 (例: MPLS-TE LSPの帯域幅) のために、任意のパケットTEモデル (例: MPLS-TEトポロジモデル) で使用できます。

contents.text: All the path and LSP bandwidth related sections in the "ietf-te-types" generic module (Section 4) need to be augmented with this grouping for the usage of packet TE technologies.
contents.ja: "ietf-te-types" 汎用モジュール (セクション4) 内のパスおよびLSPの帯域幅に関連するすべてのセクションは、パケットTE技術で使用するために、このグルーピングで拡張する必要があります。

contents.text: te-packet-link-bandwidth:
contents.ja: te-packet-link-bandwidth:

contents.text: A grouping that defines the link bandwidth information and could be used in any packet TE model (e.g., MPLS-TE topology) for link bandwidth representation.
contents.ja: リンクの帯域幅情報を定義するグルーピングです。リンク帯域幅の表現のために、任意のパケットTEモデル (例: MPLS-TEトポロジ) で使用できます。

contents.text: All the link bandwidth related sections in the "ietf-te-types" generic module (Section 4) need to be augmented with this grouping for the usage of packet TE technologies.
contents.ja: "ietf-te-types" 汎用モジュール (セクション4) 内のリンクの帯域幅に関連するすべてのセクションは、パケットTE技術で使用するために、このグルーピングで拡張する必要があります。

contents.text: 4. YANG Module for TE Types
contents.ja: 4. TE型のYANGモジュール

contents.text: The "ietf-te-types" module imports the following modules:
contents.ja: "ietf-te-types" モジュールは、次のモジュールをインポートします。

contents.text: * "ietf-yang-types" and "ietf-inet-types" as defined in [RFC9911]
contents.ja: * [RFC9911] で定義されている "ietf-yang-types" および "ietf-inet-types"

contents.text: * "ietf-routing-types" as defined in [RFC8294]
contents.ja: * [RFC8294] で定義されている "ietf-routing-types"

contents.text: * "ietf-network" and "ietf-network-topology" as defined in [RFC8345]
contents.ja: * [RFC8345] で定義されている "ietf-network" および "ietf-network-topology"

contents.text: Importantly, even where the definition of a type or grouping references a technology-specific document, this does not preclude its use for other technologies.
contents.ja: 重要な点として、型やグルーピングの定義が特定の技術に固有の文書を参照している場合でも、他の技術での使用が妨げられるわけではありません。

      reference

        uses performance-metrics-thresholds;

    }
  }

  grouping label-restriction-info {
    description
      "Label set item information.";
    leaf restriction {
      type enumeration {
        enum inclusive {
          description
            "The label or label range is inclusive.";
        }
        enum exclusive {
          description
            "The label or label range is exclusive.";
        }
      }
      default "inclusive";
      description
        "Indicates whether the list item is inclusive or exclusive.";
    }
    leaf index {
      type uint32;
      description
        "The index of the label restriction list entry.";
    }
    container label-start {
      must "(not(../label-end/te-label/direction) and"
         + " not(te-label/direction))"
         + " or "
         + "(../label-end/te-label/direction = te-label/direction)"
         + " or "
         + "(not(te-label/direction) and"
         + " (../label-end/te-label/direction = 'forward'))"
         + " or "
         + "(not(../label-end/te-label/direction) and"
         + " (te-label/direction = 'forward'))" {
        error-message "'label-start' and 'label-end' must have the "
                    + "same direction.";
      }
      description
        "This is the starting label if a label range is specified.
         This is the label value if a single label is specified;
         in which case, the 'label-end' attribute is not set.";
      uses te-label;
    }
    container label-end {
      must "(not(../label-start/te-label/direction) and"
         + " not(te-label/direction))"
         + " or "
         + "(../label-start/te-label/direction = "
         + "te-label/direction)"
         + " or "
         + "(not(te-label/direction) and"
         + " (../label-start/te-label/direction = 'forward'))"
         + " or "
         + "(not(../label-start/te-label/direction) and"
         + " (te-label/direction = 'forward'))" {
        error-message "'label-start' and 'label-end' must have the "
                    + "same direction.";
      }
      description
        "This is the ending label if a label range is specified.
         This attribute is not set if a single label is specified.";
      uses te-label;
    }
    container label-step {
      description
        "The step increment between labels in the label range.

         The label start/end values MUST be consistent with the sign
         of label step.

         For example:
            'label-start' < 'label-end' enforces 'label-step' > 0
            'label-start' > 'label-end' enforces 'label-step' < 0.";
      choice technology {
        default "generic";
        description
          "Data plane technology type.";
        case generic {
          leaf generic {
            type int32;
            default "1";
            description
              "Label range step.";
          }
        }
      }
    }
    leaf range-bitmap {
      type yang:hex-string;
      description
        "When there are gaps between 'label-start' and 'label-end',
         this attribute is used to specify the positions
         of the used labels.

         This is represented in big endian as 'hex-string'.

         In case the restriction is 'inclusive', the bit-position is
         set if the corresponding mapped label is available.
         In this case, if the range-bitmap is not present, all the
         labels in the range are available.

         In case the restriction is 'exclusive', the bit-position is
         set if the corresponding mapped label is not available.
         In this case, if the range-bitmap is not present, all the
         labels in the range are not available.

         The most significant byte in the hex-string is the farthest
         to the left in the byte sequence.

         Leading zero bytes in the configured value may be omitted
         for brevity.

         Each bit position in the 'range-bitmap' 'hex-string' maps
         to a label in the range derived from 'label-start'.

         For example, assuming that 'label-start' = 16000 and
         'range-bitmap' = 0x01000001, then:
         - bit position (0) is set, and the corresponding mapped
           label from the range is 16000 + (0 * 'label-step') or
           16000 for default 'label-step' = 1.
         - bit position (24) is set, and the corresponding mapped
           label from the range is 16000 + (24 * 'label-step') or
           16024 for default 'label-step' = 1.";
    }
  }

  grouping label-set-info {
    description
      "Grouping for the list of label restrictions specifying what
       labels may or may not be used.";
    container label-restrictions {
      description
        "The label restrictions container.";
      list label-restriction {
        key "index";
        description
          "The absence of the label restrictions container implies
           that all labels are acceptable; otherwise, only restricted
           labels are available.";
        reference
          "RFC 7579: General Network Element Constraint Encoding
                     for GMPLS-Controlled Networks";
        uses label-restriction-info;
      }
    }
  }

  grouping optimization-metric-entry {
    description
      "Optimization metrics configuration grouping.";
    leaf metric-type {
      type identityref {
        base path-metric-optimization-type;
      }
      description
        "Identifies the 'metric-type' that the path computation
         process uses for optimization.";
    }
    leaf weight {
      type uint8;
      default "1";
      description
        "TE path metric normalization weight.";
    }
    container explicit-route-exclude-objects {
      when "../metric-type = "
         + "'te-types:path-metric-optimize-excludes'";
      description
        "Container for the 'exclude route' object list.";
      uses path-route-exclude-objects;
    }
    container explicit-route-include-objects {
      when "../metric-type = "
         + "'te-types:path-metric-optimize-includes'";
      description
        "Container for the 'include route' object list.";
      uses path-route-include-objects;
    }
  }

  grouping common-constraints {
    description
      "Common constraints grouping that can be set on
       a constraint set or directly on the tunnel.";
    uses te-bandwidth {
      description
        "A requested bandwidth to use for path computation.";
    }
    leaf link-protection {
      type identityref {
        base link-protection-type;
      }
      default "te-types:link-protection-unprotected";
      description
        "Link protection type required for the links included
         in the computed path.";
      reference
        "RFC 4202: Routing Extensions in Support of
                   Generalized Multi-Protocol Label Switching
                   (GMPLS)";
    }
    leaf setup-priority {
      type uint8 {
        range "0..7";
      }
      default "7";
      description
        "TE LSP requested setup priority.";
      reference
        "RFC 3209: RSVP-TE: Extensions to RSVP for LSP Tunnels";
    }
    leaf hold-priority {
      type uint8 {
        range "0..7";
      }
      default "7";
      description
        "TE LSP requested hold priority.";
      reference
        "RFC 3209: RSVP-TE: Extensions to RSVP for LSP Tunnels";
    }
    leaf signaling-type {
      type identityref {
        base path-signaling-type;
      }
      default "te-types:path-setup-rsvp";
      description
        "TE tunnel path signaling type.";
    }
  }

  grouping tunnel-constraints {
    description
      "Tunnel constraints grouping that can be set on
       a constraint set or directly on the tunnel.";
    leaf network-id {
      type nw:network-id;
      description
        "The network topology identifier.";
    }
    uses te-topology-identifier;
    uses common-constraints;
  }

  grouping path-constraints-route-objects {
    description
      "List of route entries to be included or excluded when
       performing the path computation.";
    container explicit-route-objects {
      description
        "Container for the Explicit Route Object lists.";
      list route-object-exclude-always {
        key "index";
        ordered-by user;
        description
          "List of route objects to always exclude from the path
           computation.";
        leaf index {
          type uint32;
          description
            "Explicit Route Object index.

             The index is used to identify an entry in the list.

             The order of entries is defined by the user without
             relying on key values.";
        }
        uses explicit-route-hop {
          refine "type/numbered-node-hop/numbered-node-hop"
               + "/hop-type" {
            must '. = "strict"' {
              description
                "Loose hops can only be used for 'include' route
                 objects.";
              reference
                "RFC 4874: Exclude Routes - Extension to Resource
                          ReserVation Protocol-Traffic Engineering
                          (RSVP-TE), Section 3.1";
            }
          }
        }
      }
      list route-object-include-exclude {
        key "index";
        ordered-by user;
        description
          "List of route objects to include or exclude in the path
           computation.";
        leaf explicit-route-usage {
          type identityref {
            base route-usage-type;
          }
          default "te-types:route-include-object";
          description
            "Indicates whether to include or exclude the
             route object.

             The default is to include it.";
        }
        leaf index {
          type uint32;
          description
            "Route object include-exclude index.

             The index is used to identify an entry in the list.

             The order of entries is defined by the user without
             relying on key values.";
        }
        uses explicit-route-hop-with-srlg {
          refine "type/numbered-node-hop/numbered-node-hop"
               + "/hop-type" {
            must '(. = "strict") or '
               + 'derived-from-or-self(../../explicit-route-usage,'
               + '"te-types:route-include-object")' {
              description
                "Loose hops can only be used for 'include' route
                 objects.";
              reference
                "RFC 4874: Exclude Routes - Extension to Resource
                          ReserVation Protocol-Traffic Engineering
                          (RSVP-TE), Section 3.1";
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  grouping path-route-include-objects {
    description
      "List of route objects to be included when performing
       the path computation.";
    list route-object-include-object {
      key "index";
      ordered-by user;
      description
        "List of Explicit Route Objects to be included in the
         path computation.";
      leaf index {
        type uint32;
        description
          "Route object entry index.

             The index is used to identify an entry in the list.

             The order of entries is defined by the user without
             relying on key values.";
      }
      uses explicit-route-hop;
    }
  }

  grouping path-route-exclude-objects {
    description
      "List of route objects to be excluded when performing
       the path computation.";
    list route-object-exclude-object {
      key "index";
      ordered-by user;
      description
        "List of Explicit Route Objects to be excluded in the
         path computation.";
      leaf index {
        type uint32;
        description
          "Route object entry index.

             The index is used to identify an entry in the list.

             The order of entries is defined by the user without
             relying on key values.";
      }
      uses explicit-route-hop-with-srlg;
    }
  }

  grouping generic-path-metric-bounds {
    description
      "TE path metric bounds grouping.";
    container path-metric-bounds {
      description
        "Top-level container for the list of path metric bounds.";
      list path-metric-bound {
        key "metric-type";
        description
          "List of path metric bounds, which can apply to link and
           path metrics.

           TE paths that have at least one path metric that
           exceeds the specified bounds MUST NOT be selected.

           TE paths that traverse TE links that have at least one
           link metric that exceeds the specified bounds MUST NOT
           be selected.";
        leaf metric-type {
          type identityref {
            base link-path-metric-type;
          }
          description
            "Identifies an entry in the list of 'metric-type' items
             bound for the TE path.";
        }
        leaf upper-bound {
          type uint64;
          default "0";
          description
            "Upper bound on the specified 'metric-type'.

             A zero indicates an unbounded upper limit for the
             specified 'metric-type'.

             The unit of the upper bound is interpreted in the
             context of the 'metric-type' identity.";
        }
      }
    }
  }

  grouping generic-path-optimization {
    description
      "TE generic path optimization grouping.";
    container optimizations {
      description
        "The objective function container that includes
         attributes to impose when computing a TE path.";
      choice algorithm {
        description
          "Optimizations algorithm.";
        case metric {
          if-feature "path-optimization-metric";
          /* Optimize by metric */
          list optimization-metric {
            key "metric-type";
            description
              "TE path metric type.";
            uses optimization-metric-entry;
          }
          /* Tiebreakers */
          container tiebreakers {
            status deprecated;
            description
              "Container for the list of tiebreakers.

               This container has been deprecated by the tiebreaker
               leaf.";
            list tiebreaker {
              key "tiebreaker-type";
              status deprecated;
              description
                "The list of tiebreaker criteria to apply on an
                 equally favored set of paths, in order to pick
                 the best.";
              leaf tiebreaker-type {
                type identityref {
                  base path-metric-type;
                }
                status deprecated;
                description
                  "Identifies an entry in the list of tiebreakers.";
              }
            }
          }
        }
        case objective-function {
          if-feature "path-optimization-objective-function";
          /* Objective functions */
          container objective-function {
            description
              "The objective function container that includes
               attributes to impose when computing a TE path.";
            leaf objective-function-type {
              type identityref {
                base objective-function-type;
              }
              default "te-types:of-minimize-cost-path";
              description
                "Objective function entry.";
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
    leaf tiebreaker {
      type identityref {
        base path-tiebreaker-type;
      }
      default "te-types:path-tiebreaker-random";
      description
        "The tiebreaker criteria to apply on an equally favored set
         of paths, in order to pick the best.";
    }
  }

  grouping generic-path-affinities {
    description
      "Path affinities grouping.";
    container path-affinities-values {
      description
        "Path affinities represented as values.";
      list path-affinities-value {
        key "usage";
        description
          "List of named affinity constraints.";
        leaf usage {
          type identityref {
            base resource-affinities-type;
          }
          description
            "Identifies an entry in the list of value affinity
             constraints.";
        }
        leaf value {
          type admin-groups;
          default "";
          description
            "The affinity value.

             The default is empty.";
        }
      }
    }
    container path-affinity-names {
      description
        "Path affinities represented as names.";
      list path-affinity-name {
        key "usage";
        description
          "List of named affinity constraints.";
        leaf usage {
          type identityref {
            base resource-affinities-type;
          }
          description
            "Identifies an entry in the list of named affinity
             constraints.";
        }
        list affinity-name {
          key "name";
          description
            "List of named affinities.";
          leaf name {
            type string;
            description
              "Identifies a named affinity entry.";
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  grouping generic-path-srlgs {
    description
      "Path SRLG grouping.";
    container path-srlgs-lists {
      description
        "Path SRLG properties container.";
      list path-srlgs-list {
        key "usage";
        description
          "List of SRLG values to be
           included or excluded.";
        leaf usage {
          type identityref {
            base route-usage-type;
          }
          description
            "Identifies an entry in a list of SRLGs to
             either include or exclude.";
        }
        leaf-list values {
          type srlg;
          description
            "List of SRLG values.";
        }
      }
    }
    container path-srlgs-names {
      description
        "Container for the list of named SRLGs.";
      list path-srlgs-name {
        key "usage";
        description
          "List of named SRLGs to be included or excluded.";
        leaf usage {
          type identityref {
            base route-usage-type;
          }
          description
            "Identifies an entry in a list of named SRLGs to
             either include or exclude.";
        }
        leaf-list names {
          type string;
          description
            "List of named SRLGs.";
        }
      }
    }
  }

  grouping generic-path-disjointness {
    description
      "Path disjointness grouping.";
    leaf disjointness {
      type te-path-disjointness;
      description
        "The type of resource disjointness.
         When configured for a primary path, the disjointness level
         applies to all secondary LSPs.

         When configured for a secondary path, the disjointness
         level overrides the level configured for the primary path.";
    }
  }

  grouping common-path-constraints-attributes {
    description
      "Common path constraints configuration grouping.";
    uses common-constraints;
    uses generic-path-metric-bounds;
    uses generic-path-affinities;
    uses generic-path-srlgs;
  }

  grouping generic-path-constraints {
    description
      "Global named path constraints configuration grouping.";
    container path-constraints {
      description
        "TE named path constraints container.";
      uses common-path-constraints-attributes;
      uses generic-path-disjointness;
    }
  }

  grouping generic-path-properties {
    description
      "TE generic path properties grouping.";
    container path-properties {
      config false;
      description
        "The TE path properties.";
      list path-metric {
        key "metric-type";
        description
          "TE path metric type.";
        leaf metric-type {
          type identityref {
            base path-metric-type;
          }
          description
            "TE path metric type.";
        }
        leaf accumulative-value {
          type uint64;
          description
            "TE path metric accumulative value.";
        }
      }
      uses generic-path-affinities;
      uses generic-path-srlgs;
      container path-route-objects {
        description
          "Container for the list of route objects either returned by
           the computation engine or actually used by an LSP.";
        list path-route-object {
          key "index";
          ordered-by user;
          description
            "List of route objects either returned by the computation
             engine or actually used by an LSP.";
          leaf index {
            type uint32;
            description
              "Route object entry index.

               The index is used to identify an entry in the list.

               The order of entries is defined by the user without
               relying on key values.";
          }
          uses explicit-route-hop;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  grouping encoding-and-switching-type {
    description
      "Common grouping to define the LSP encoding and
       switching types";
    leaf encoding {
      type identityref {
        base te-types:lsp-encoding-types;
      }
      description
        "LSP encoding type.";
      reference
        "RFC 3945: Generalized Multi-Protocol Label Switching (GMPLS)
                   Architecture";
    }
    leaf switching-type {
      type identityref {
        base te-types:switching-capabilities;
      }
      description
        "LSP switching type.";
      reference
        "RFC 3945: Generalized Multi-Protocol Label Switching (GMPLS)
                   Architecture";
    }
  }

  grouping te-generic-node-id {
    description
      "A reusable grouping for a TE generic node identifier.";
    leaf id {
      type union {
        type te-node-id;
        type inet:ip-address;
        type nw:node-id;
      }
      description
        "The identifier of the node.

         It can be represented as an IP address, a dotted quad
         address, or a URI.

         The type data node disambiguates the union type.";
    }
    leaf type {
      type enumeration {
        enum ip {
          description
            "IP address representation of the node identifier.";
        }
        enum te-id {
          description
            "TE identifier of the node";
        }
        enum node-id {
          description
            "URI representation of the node identifier.";
        }
      }
      description
        "Type of node identifier representation.";
    }
  }
}

  revision 2026-11-17 {

  /*

   */

    description
      "Bandwidth profile types";

  identity mef-10 {
    base bandwidth-profile-type;
    description
      "MEF 10 bandwidth profile";
    reference
      "MEF 10.3: Ethernet Services Attributes Phase 3";
  }

  identity rfc-2697 {
    base bandwidth-profile-type;
    description
      "RFC 2697 bandwidth profile";
    reference
      "RFC 2697: A Single Rate Three Color Marker";

  identity rfc-2698 {
    base bandwidth-profile-type;
    description
      "RFC 2698 bandwidth profile";
    reference
      "RFC 2698: A Two Rate Three Color Marker";
  }

    reference

                 Section 4.3
       RFC 8570: IS-IS Traffic Engineering (TE) Metric Extensions,
                 Section 4.3";
  }

  identity link-metric-loss {
    base te-types:link-metric-type;
    description
      "The Unidirectional Link Loss Metric,
       measured in units of 0.000003%.";
    reference
      "RFC 7471: OSPF Traffic Engineering (TE) Metric Extensions,
                 Section 4.4
       RFC 8570: IS-IS Traffic Engineering (TE) Metric Extensions,
                 Section 4.4";
  }

  // Derived identities from te-types:path-metric-type

  identity path-metric-delay-variation {
    base te-types:path-metric-type;
    description

contents.text: The Network Configuration Access Control Model (NACM) [RFC8341] provides the means to restrict access for particular NETCONF or RESTCONF users to a preconfigured subset of all available NETCONF or RESTCONF protocol operations and content.
